confirmedFindings.title: HMAC-SHA256 Truncation to 8 Hex Characters
confirmedFindings.body: Truncating the HMAC-SHA256 digest to 8 hexadecimal characters reduces the signature key space from 256 bits to only 32 bits (4 billion possibilities), allowing trivial signature forgery via brute-force attack.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Return the complete 64-character hex string from hmac.digest('hex').
